raw_segments.text: Fabian, good madam, hear me speak, and let no quarrel nor no brawl to come taint the
condition of this present hour, which I have wondered at.
In hope it shall not, most freely I confess, myself and Toby set this device against Malvolio
here, upon some stubborn and uncurdious parts we had conceived against him.

How with a sportful malice it was followed may rather pluck on laughter than revenge,
if that the injuries be justly weighed that have on both sides passed.
